from pathlib import Path

programs=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-prime-agent-luna6-medium-seq0/frozen/held-out/play/users/u052/system/state/workspace/programs')

code='''from collections import deque

def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen = set()
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] == 8 or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            q = deque([(r, c)])
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while q:
                y, x = q.popleft()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for yy, xx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
                    if 0 <= yy < h and 0 <= xx < w and grid[yy][xx] != 8 and (yy,xx) not in seen:
                        seen.add((yy,xx)); q.append((yy,xx))
            y0, y1 = min(y for y,x in cells), max(y for y,x in cells)
            x0, x1 = min(x for y,x in cells), max(x for y,x in cells)
            colored = [(y,x) for y,x in cells if grid[y][x] not in (0,8)]
            py0, py1 = min(y for y,x in colored), max(y for y,x in colored)
            px0, px1 = min(x for y,x in colored), max(x for y,x in colored)
            ph, pw = py1-py0+1, px1-px0+1
            tile = [[grid[py0+i][px0+j] for j in range(pw)] for i in range(ph)]
            for y in range(y0, y1+1):
                for x in range(x0, x1+1):
                    out[y][x] = tile[(y-py0)%ph][(x-px0)%pw]
    return out
'''
